They somehow forgot that Elon Musk built both Tesla & SpaceX simultaneously to trillion-plus valuations.  Tesla has always been volatile, a SpaceX IPO is just this week’s excuse.  Traders make money from volatility.

These analysts are ALREADY WRONG. Within 3 months of AJ’s doomsday 2/25 analysis, Tesla & SpaceX are deepening a mutually beneficial partnership. This isn’t a zero-sum game. Instead of each company remaining on a trajectory to be an $8 Trillion company, Elon Musk leveled up to a new 100 Trillion market cap goal.

Instead of competition between Musk companies and divided loyalty, Elon Musk has tasked Tesla/SpaceX/xAI with one audacious mission: remove the constraint of Earth and its limited resources by kick-starting a true Space Economy flywheel. ELON MUSK: The Future of AI Compute Lies in Space, Not on Earth.

“Once you think in terms of harnessing the Sun’s power, you realize scaling massively on Earth is impossible. The entire US averages just ~0.5 TW of electricity. A single terawatt—twice that—requires enormous power plants, transformers, and infrastructure that’s extremely hard to build and scale.
Solar is already cheap, but in space it’s ~10x cheaper: constant sunlight, no batteries needed. The moment low-cost access to space arrives, the cheapest and most scalable way to generate AI tokens will be in orbit—by far. In 5 years, it’ll be an order of magnitude easier.
Prediction: We’ll soon launch and operate more AI compute in space each year than the cumulative total on Earth.”

This keeps the key points (Sun’s power scale, Earth limits, solar advantages in space, Colossus reference implied in scaling difficulty, bold prediction) but trims repetition and improves flow for shareability.

STARSHIP IS THE VEHICLE THAT WILL MAKE HUMANITY MULTIPLANETARY

Starship isn’t just a rocket.

It’s the first machine in history specifically engineered to take humanity beyond Earth for good.

Here’s why Starship is so important:

•  Full reusability — Both the Super Heavy booster and Starship upper stage are designed to fly again and again, dropping launch costs from hundreds of millions to just a few million dollars per flight.
•  Orbital refueling breakthrough — Ship-to-ship propellant transfer in orbit is the single hardest challenge. Once proven, it unlocks the Moon and Mars with massive payloads — no other vehicle can do this at scale.
•  Massive payload capacity — 100–150+ tons reusable to orbit (future versions even higher). Enough to deliver entire habitats, power systems, and crew in single flights.
•  Rapid cadence for Mars — Only Starship can launch often enough to deliver the millions of tons of cargo needed to build a self-sustaining city on Mars.
•  Moon as the perfect rehearsal — Starship HLS is NASA’s chosen lander for Artemis. Lunar missions prove refueling, landings, ISRU, and surface ops in a real space environment with much shorter feedback loops than Mars.

Elon Musk on Starship’s true purpose:

“Starship is designed to make life multiplanetary, otherwise extreme overkill for mere Earth sector activity.”

OPTIMUS IS ALREADY WORKING IN TESLA FACTORIES — THIS WILL BE TESLA’S BIGGEST PRODUCT EVER

Optimus isn’t a distant prototype anymore.
It’s already performing real, useful tasks inside Giga Texas and Giga Nevada right now.

From moving parts and sorting inventory to handling repetitive assembly steps, early Optimus units are proving they can operate safely and reliably in the fast-paced chaos of a real Gigafactory.

Here’s why this matters so much for humanity:

•  Ending dangerous and grueling labor — Optimus will take on mining, heavy construction, factory welding, disaster cleanup, and other high-risk jobs so humans don’t have to suffer or die doing them.
•  Solving the global care crisis — Round-the-clock assistance for the elderly, people with disabilities, and those recovering from illness — helping with mobility, daily tasks, and companionship.
•  Creating true economic abundance — When physical labor becomes extremely cheap and scalable, the cost of goods, housing, food, and services collapses worldwide, raising living standards for billions.
•  Building humanity’s future on other worlds — Optimus will be the workforce that constructs habitats, mines resources, assembles solar arrays, and maintains life support on the Moon and Mars.

Elon Musk on Optimus:

“Optimus will be the biggest product ever.”
This isn’t dystopian automation.
It’s liberation.
It’s abundance.
It’s the next chapter of human progress.

NEURALINK IS ALREADY CHANGING LIVES — AND IT’S JUST GETTING STARTED

Neuralink isn’t a distant sci-fi concept anymore.

It’s real, it’s implanted in humans right now, and it’s restoring capabilities that were once considered permanently lost.

Here’s why Neuralink’s impact is so profound:
•  Restoring independence to paralyzed people — Patients who lost use of their hands or entire bodies can now move cursors, type, play games, and browse the internet using only their thoughts. No joysticks, no eye-tracking, no assistants needed.
•  Blindsight on the horizon — The next major leap (pending approval) is restoring vision even for people who are completely blind, starting at low resolution and improving over time.
•  Full body functionality coming — The long-term goal is to give people with spinal cord injuries or neurological damage full control of their limbs again — walking, using hands, regaining independence.
•  Human-AI symbiosis — Beyond fixing disabilities, Neuralink is building a high-bandwidth link between the brain and AI so humanity can keep pace with superintelligence instead of being left behind.
Elon Musk on Neuralink’s true purpose:
“The goal of Neuralink is to achieve a symbiosis with AI, to help humans keep up with AI and not be left behind.”
This is more than medical technology.
This is the beginning of the next chapter of human evolution — where disabilities are reversed, dignity is restored, and humanity gains the tools to thrive alongside superintelligent AI.
